dialogue: Carrington. A private meeting to clear the air. Jason had invited a camera crew.
Bruno, if you've got a problem with the tactics, tell me. Not the television.
I tried. You said your door was always open.
Look. Maybe I could've been clearer.
And maybe I shouldn't have said it on telly.
Yes. I still think the tactics were shit.
Aye. But now you've told me indoors. Progress.
Clearing the air. It's on the agenda.
Next time, just come straight to me.
